description.content:
VPNs endpoints are used to create the WAN Assurance Overlay configuration between a Hub and one
or multiple WAN Edge Gateways.


When configuring the Hub and Spokes from the Mist UI, the UI is automatically creating or updating
the VPNs objects based on the configuration. 
When the configuration is directly done with the APIs, the VPN object must be manually managed.
